content: XML Configuration of classes with atpMixedString The following default values are applied to classes with stereotype atpMixedString (if no other values are specified in the meta-model): • Default values of the stereotyped meta-class:  xml.ordered=false  xml.text=true • Default values of the properties of the stereotyped meta-class:  upper multiplicity = unbounded  lower multiplicity = 0  xml.roleWrapperElement = false 42 of 90  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 122: AUTOSAR_TPS_XMLSchemaProductionRules AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules AUTOSAR CP R19-11  xml.roleElement = true  xml.typeWrapperElement = false  xml.typeElement = true (if the type of the property has concrete subclasses), false (otherwise)
